feeds.title: Calligraphy Cards - Shaz in Oz
feeds.description: I have been doing Calligraphy since teens, and card making for many years as well. In 1990 I delighted in the joys of stamping with ink and embossing after a trip to Cairns, Qld. In 2009 I discovered the brayer, 2010 the Cuttlebug, also have now taking to reading up on crafting blogs and lo! Here I am, on one of my own.

feeds.title: Calligraphy Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Molly Suber Thorpe. I design custom lettering for brands and individuals around the world, digital assets for lettering artists, and tools for creative freelancers. Since 2009, I have worked with clients including Google Arts & Culture, Michael Kors, Martha Stewart, Lonely Planet, and Fendi. My work has been featured in such publications as The Guardian, The Wall Street Journal, Martha Stewart Weddings, Los Angeles Times, and Buzzfeed. At my blog I post video tutorials, calligraphy workshop announcements, Procreate lettering tips, favorite supplies, new product releases, and more.

feeds.title: Crooked Calligraphy Blog
feeds.description: I'm Shinah - a whiskey-loving, curse-word slinging, Harvard-trained former corporate attorney who left everything behind to find my passion. And, who knew?! That passion is a modern calligraphy and I'm pretty damn good at it. Hear more about my journey from corporate lawyer to full-time calligrapher and calligraphy teacher at my blog Crooked Calligraphy.

feeds.title: Calligraphic Connections Blog
feeds.description: My name is Lyndell Dobbs and I am based in the National Capital of Australia. My blog is a record of my interests and work. I have a strong interest in calligraphy, bookbinding, book artistry, printing and photography. I am a member of both the Canberra Calligraphy Society and the Canberra Craft Bookbinders Guild.

feeds.title: Calligraphy by CT Blog
feeds.description: Beautiful calligraphy by hand & unique stationery for weddings & special events. So many of your elements will come to life with hand lettering: Outer and inner invitation envelopes, place cards & escort cards, table numbers, personalized napkin bands for your table linens and more!

feeds.description: Creative Calligraphy is a woman-owned business that focuses on the vintage art of Arabic calligraphy. We strive to create a spiritual community around the art of Arabic calligraphy, and poetry of 13th century Sufi poet Rumi.We offer calligraphy workshops, design wedding invitations, and provide handmade Vintage Arabic calligraphy Artworks, tools and supplies.

feeds.title: Paul Herrera Calligrapher-Artist
feeds.description: Paul Herrera's calligraphy and lettering training was done exclusively with Reverend E. M. Catich. Beginning as an undergraduate in 1967 and after a short interruption of military service, Paul worked as inscription cutter and calligraphy seminar assistant with Father Catich until the time of his death in 1979.

feeds.title: Calligraphy and Lettering Blog
feeds.description: Paper and Ink Arts is a calligraphy and specialty art supply store in Nashville, TN. We offer nibs, holders, inks, papers, and all of the accouterments you need for lettering. Our blog was created to educate you on how to best utilize our products and to showcase the talents of our customers. From starting new or moving into more advanced techniques, we aim to provide you many ways to learn.
